the halo of M31 has a significant intermediate-age population.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the halo of M31, like that of the Milky Way, is a complex system that is best understood by considering the full range of ages, metallicities, and spatial distributions of its stellar populations.
the M31 globular cluster system is not a good tracer of the halo stellar populations, and that the halo contains a much more diverse range of ages and metallicities than previously recognized.
